passages.label: Prop. 4.1.1
passages.text: hoc, quodcumque uides, hospes, qua maxima Roma est,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.2
passages.text: ante Phrygem Aenean collis et herba fuit;

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.3
passages.text: atque ubi Nauali stant sacra Palatia Phoebo,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.4
passages.text: Euandri profugae concubuere boues.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.5
passages.text: fictilibus creuere deis haec aurea templa,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.6
passages.text: nec fuit opprobrio facta sine arte casa;

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.7
passages.text: Tarpeiusque pater nuda de rupe tonabat,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.8
passages.text: et Tiberis nostris aduena bubus erat.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.9
passages.text: qua gradibus domus ista Remi se sustulit, olim

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.10
passages.text: unus erat fratrum maxima regna focus.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.11
passages.text: curia, praetexto quae nunc nitet alta senatu,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.12
passages.text: pellitos habuit, rustica corda, Patres.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.13
passages.text: bucina cogebat priscos ad uerba Quiritis:

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.14
passages.text: centum illi in prato saepe senatus erat.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.15
passages.text: nec sinuosa cauo pendebant uela theatro,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.16
passages.text: pulpita sollemnis non oluere crocos.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.17
passages.text: nulli cura fuit externos quaerere diuos,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.18
passages.text: cum tremeret patrio pendula turba sacro,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.19
passages.text: annuaque accenso celebrante Parilia faeno,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.20
passages.text: qualia nunc curto lustra nouantur equo.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.21
passages.text: Vesta coronatis pauper gaudebat asellis,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.22
passages.text: ducebant macrae uilia sacra boues.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.23
passages.text: parua saginati lustrabant compita porci,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.24
passages.text: pastor et ad calamos exta litabat ouis.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.25
passages.text: uerbera pellitus saetosa mouebat arator,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.26
passages.text: unde licens Fabius sacra Lupercus habet.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.27
passages.text: nec rudis infestis miles radiabat in armis:

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.28
passages.text: miscebant usta proelia nuda sude.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.29
passages.text: prima galeritus posuit praetoria Lycmon,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.30
passages.text: magnaque pars Tatio rerum erat inter ouis.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.31
passages.text: hinc Tities Ramnesque uiri Luceresque Soloni,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.32
passages.text: quattuor hinc albos Romulus egit equos.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.33
passages.text: quippe suburbanae parua minus urbe Bouillae

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.34
passages.text: et, qui nunc nulli, maxima turba Gabi.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.35
passages.text: et stetit Alba potens, albae suis omine nata,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.36
passages.text: ac tibi Fidenas longa erat isse uia.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.37
passages.text: nil patrium nisi nomen habet Romanus alumnus:

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.38
passages.text: sanguinis altricem non pudet esse lupam.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.39
passages.text: huc melius profugos misisti, Troia, Penatis;

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.40
passages.text: heu quali uecta est Dardana puppis aue!

passages.text: iam bene spondebant tunc omina, quod nihil illam

passages.text: laeserat abiegni uenter apertus equi,

passages.text: cum pater in nati trepidus ceruice pependit,

passages.text: et uerita est umeros urere flamma pios.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.45
passages.text: tunc animi uenere Deci Brutique secures,

passages.text: uexit et ipsa sui Caesaris arma Venus,

passages.text: arma resurgentis portans uictricia Troiae:

passages.text: felix terra tuos cepit, Iule, deos,

passages.text: si modo Auernalis tremulae cortina Sibyllae

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.50
passages.text: dixit Auentino rura pianda Remo,

passages.text: aut si Pergameae sero rata carmina uatis

passages.text: longaeuum ad Priami uera fuere caput:

passages.text: ‘uertite equum, Danai! male uincitis! Ilia tellus

passages.text: uiuet, et huic cineri Iuppiter arma dabit.’

passages.text: optima nutricum nostris lupa Martia rebus,

passages.text: fluxerit, hoc patriae seruiet omne meae.

passages.text: Ennius hirsuta cingat sua dicta corona:

passages.text: Vmbria Romani patria Callimachi!

passages.text: scandentis quisquis cernit de uallibus arces,

passages.text: Roma, faue, tibi surgit opus, date candida ciues

passages.text: sacra diesque canam et cognomina prisca locorum:

passages.text: has meus ad metas sudet oportet equus.

passages.text: quo ruis imprudens, uage, dicere fata, Properti?

passages.text: accersis lacrimas cantans, auersus Apollo:

passages.text: certa feram certis auctoribus, aut ego uates

passages.text: me creat Archytae suboles Babylonius Orops

passages.text: nunc pretium fecere deos et (fallitur auro

passages.text: felicesque Iouis stellas Martisque rapaces

passages.text: quid moueant Pisces animosaque signa Leonis,

passages.text: quippe Lupercus, equi dum saucia protegit ora,

passages.text: uera, sed inuito, contigit ista fides.

passages.text: hoc neque harenosum Libyae Iouis explicat antrum,

passages.text: et natat exuuiis Graecia pressa suis.

passages.text: uictor Oiliade, rape nunc et dilige uatem,

passages.text: quam uetat auelli ueste Minerua sua!

passages.text: hactenus historiae: nunc ad tua deuehar astra;

passages.text: mentior? an patriae tangitur ora tuae?—

passages.text: qua nebulosa cauo rorat Meuania campo,

passages.text: et lacus aestiuis intepet Vmber aquis,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.125

passages.text: murus ab ingenio notior ille tuo.

passages.text: ossaque legisti non illa aetate legenda

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.128
passages.text: patris et in tenuis cogeris ipse lares:

passages.text: nam tua cum multi uersarent rura iuuenci,

passages.text: abstulit excultas pertica tristis opes.

passages.text: mox ubi bulla rudi dimissa est aurea collo,

passages.text: matris et ante deos libera sumpta toga,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.135
passages.text: at tu finge elegos, fallax opus: haec tua castra! -

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.136
passages.text: scribat ut exemplo cetera turba tuo.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.137
passages.text: militiam Veneris blandis patiere sub armis,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.138
passages.text: et Veneris Pueris utilis hostis eris.

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.139
passages.text: nam tibi uictrices quascumque labore parasti,

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.140
passages.text: eludit palmas una puella tuas:

passages.text: nil erit hoc: rostro te premet ansa tuo.

passages.text: nec mille excubiae nec te signata iuuabunt

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.146
passages.text: limina: persuasae fallere rima sat est.

passages.text: nunc tua uel mediis puppis luctetur in undis,

passages.text: uel licet armatis hostis inermis eas,

passages.text: uel tremefacta cauo tellus diducat hiatum:

passages.label: Prop. 4.1.150
passages.text: octipedis Cancri terga sinistra time.

passages.text: quid mirare meas tot in uno corpore formas,

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.2
passages.text: accipe Vertumni signa paterna dei.

passages.text: Tuscus ego et Tuscis orior, nec paenitet inter

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.4
passages.text: proelia Volsinios deseruisse focos.

passages.text: haec me turba iuuat, nec templo laetor eburno:

passages.text: hac quondam Tiberinus iter faciebat, et aiunt

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.8
passages.text: remorum auditos per uada pulsa sonos:

passages.text: at postquam ille suis tantum concessit alumnis,

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.12
passages.text: seu, quia uertentis fructum praecepimus anni,

passages.text: Vertumni rursus credidit esse sacrum.

passages.text: prima mihi uariat liuentibus uua racemis,

passages.text: insitor hic it pomosa uota corona,

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.20
passages.text: mendax fama, noces: alius mihi nominis index:

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.22
passages.text: opportuna mea est cunctis natura figuris:

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.23
passages.text: in quamcumque uoles uerte, decorus ero.

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.24
passages.text: indue me Cois, fiam non dura puella:

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.25
passages.text: meque uirum sumpta quis neget esse toga?

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.26
passages.text: da falcem et torto frontem mihi comprime faeno:

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.27
passages.text: iurabis nostra gramina secta manu.

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.28

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.29
passages.text: corbis et imposito pondere messor eram.

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.30
passages.text: sobrius ad lites: at cum est imposta corona,

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.31
passages.text: clamabis capiti uina subisse meo.

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.32
passages.text: cinge caput mitra, speciem furabor Iacchi;

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.33
passages.text: furabor Phoebi, si modo plectra dabis.

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.34
passages.text: cassibus impositis uenor: sed harundine sumpta

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.35

passages.text: est etiam aurigae species Vertumnus et eius

passages.label: Prop. 4.2.37
passages.text: traicit alterno qui leue pondus equo.

passages.text: suppetat hic, piscis calamo praedabor, et ibo

passages.text: at mihi, quod formas unus uertebar in omnis,

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.72
passages.text: laudat ubi emeritum libera fama rogum.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.73
passages.text: nunc tibi commendo communia pignora natos:

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.74
passages.text: haec cura et cineri spirat inusta meo.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.75
passages.text: fungere maternis uicibus, pater: illa meorum

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.76
passages.text: omnis erit collo turba ferenda tuo.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.77
passages.text: oscula cum dederis tua flentibus, adice matris:

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.78
passages.text: tota domus coepit nunc onus esse tuum.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.79
passages.text: et si quid doliturus eris, sine testibus illis!

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.80
passages.text: cum uenient, siccis oscula falle genis!

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.81
passages.text: sat tibi sint noctes, quas de me, Paulle, fatiges,

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.82
passages.text: somniaque in faciem credita saepe meam:

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.83
passages.text: atque ubi secreto nostra ad simulacra loqueris,

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.84
passages.text: ut responsurae singula uerba iace.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.85
passages.text: seu tamen aduersum mutarit ianua lectum,

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.86
passages.text: sederit et nostro cauta nouerca toro,

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.87
passages.text: coniugium, pueri, laudate et ferte paternum:

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.88
passages.text: capta dabit uestris moribus illa manus;

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.89
passages.text: nec matrem laudate nimis: collata priori

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.90
passages.text: uertet in offensas libera uerba suas.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.91
passages.text: seu memor ille mea contentus manserit umbra

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.92
passages.text: et tanti cineres duxerit esse meos,

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.93
passages.text: discite uenturam iam nunc sentire senectam,

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.94
passages.text: caelibis ad curas nec uacet ulla uia.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.95
passages.text: quod mihi detractum est, uestros accedat ad annos:

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.96
passages.text: prole mea Paullum sic iuuet esse senem.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.97
passages.text: et bene habet: numquam mater lugubria sumpsi;

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.98
passages.text: uenit in exsequias tota caterua meas.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.99
passages.text: causa perorata est. flentes me surgite, testes,

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.100
passages.text: dum pretium uitae grata rependit humus.

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.101
passages.text: moribus et caelum patuit: sim digna merendo,

passages.label: Prop. 4.11.102
passages.text: cuius honoratis ossa vehantur avis.
